name: Petra Blackberry CBN Mints [40pk] (100mg THC : 40mg CBN)
description:
2.5mg THC : 1mg CBN Per Piece | 100mg THC : 40mg CBN Total in 40 Pieces
Sweet dreams now come in small packages. Petra Blackberry CBN is Kiva’s first mood-targeting mint. Fresh blackberry and vanilla flavors are blended with sugar-free, plant-based ingredients and a calming combination of 2 MG of THC and 1 MG of CBN to create our most tranquil Petra yet. Whether it’s a power nap or a full night’s rest you need, Petra has you covered.
